surface: OpenCode Go dashboard card/settings, full-screen Usage Monitor route, progressive PWA kiosk affordances, and the landscape two-panel carousel
decisions: Preserve existing Geist Sans and JetBrains Mono, Tailwind CSS variables, and shadcn/Radix primitives.
Usage Monitor uses a flat 28px top bar, a 22px carousel rail, and exactly two fixed landscape panels; it does not use desktop dashboard navigation or tables.
Use the user-specified solid zinc-950 canvas, existing semantic colors and fonts; no new palette, invented metric, fake device chrome, or logo treatment.
Retain the existing DonutChart through an additive compact mode; remove unused monitor sparklines rather than modifying the existing dashboard.
The target is a 740x360 CSS-pixel landscape kiosk with no normal-content scrolling; device browser proof remains a separate gate.
The PWA manifest permits orientation selection while the page attempts a progressive landscape lock; unsupported browsers receive the portrait rotation gate.
